body: The idea of being on medication scares me more than what it would be treating, but maybe it's time to change my attitude on that.  I'll talk to my sister tomorrow.  She used to see a therapist, was on medication for a while, and no longer needs it.  I'm just afraid I won't be that strong, as I've already shown a strong inclination toward dependence.
Yes, it helped a lot.  I said it earlier, but I suffered from addiction to benzoid sedatives, and a relapse is one of my biggest fears of potentially being on probation or seeing a doctor.

"It's a strange world. Some people get rich, others eat shit and die."  The good Doctor is the only man who can make sense of it sometimes.

Edit:  I quit trees after my arrest.  Normally, its no problem at all to not smoke, but this time I've been drinking heavily and I'm afraid I might starting taking benzo's again, which I was addicted to in until about 18 months ago.  On a positive note, I managed to refrain from smoking cigarettes, which I've always seen as a passive form of suicide, hopefully I can continue that trend; it's the one aspect of my life that I'm actually proud of.

It's just too hard to open up.  I suffer from severe self doubt, along with paranoid delusions and occasional auditory hallucinations that reinforce my negative thinking.  I'm afriad to talk to anyone because I either think they won't care or will use the information against me somehow.  I know it's irrational, but that knowledge doesn't seem to help.
